objective: Build fix/intent-lifecycle: carry-forward acceptance, close that settles unaccepted work, reopen in use, conflict-marker detection and closed-Intent reconcile flag.
scope: Worktree worktree a, branch release/0.2.0/fix/intent-lifecycle, based on release/0.2.0/feat/collaborative-intents (PR #21).
constraints: No change to the persisted record schema (Intent, Assignment, acceptance); older 0.2.0-stack CLIs must still read every record this one writes.
Follow AGENTS.md and the ship brief; JSDoc on exports; Effect tagged errors; Bun Shell only if a process is needed (none expected).
acceptance_criteria: assignment accept --carry-forward accepts a Succeeded Assignment whose intent_revision is below the live revision when the acceptance's intent_revision equals the live one; without the flag the old StaleRevision refusal stands; the flag on a same-revision Assignment is refused or a no-op, stated and tested; rationale must be non-blank.

intent close refuses with a tagged error listing every Succeeded-unaccepted Assignment of that Intent; an override flag (name of your choice, e.g. --allow-unaccepted <reason>) closes anyway and records the reason in close_reason without a new field.
intent reopen sets the reopened Intent in use and reports in_use and replaced like intent create; intent use refuses a closed Intent (add the test if missing).
Loading a record that contains git conflict markers fails with an error naming the record path and saying to resolve the conflict in git, then rerun.
reconcile lists a closed Intent that still has Ready or Running Assignments as a flagged row.

Root prompt plugin/agents/holyclaude.md and plugin/skills/assignments/SKILL.md gain: carry-forward use (rationale says why the work still holds; dispatch a validation Assignment instead when the change touched the work's files), close override, and pull before closing an Intent. Compact; state the wc -c size change. The core-rules block between the markers stays within its existing size unless a line must go there.
README documents the new flags briefly.
Tests cover each behavior; bundle rebuilt; fmt, lint, typecheck and full test pass.
result: A built: accept --carry-forward (no-op at live revision), intent close refuses with UnacceptedAssignments and --allow-unaccepted <reason> folded into close_reason, reopen sets in use and reports in_use/replaced, readJson reports CorruptRecord for git conflict markers, reconcile closed_with_open_work rows; prompt, skill and README updated; 1229 tests pass; one unidentified failure in a first full run did not recur.
